items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: Too bad about that, Riley Puckett.

ctx.x: I want to run a couple of statements by you and just get your impression on them. You don’t have to say no that’s not correct or that’s correct, but I’ve often read the phrase “Jazz is the only original American art form.”
Too bad about that, Riley Puckett. You know? What about the Carter family? Nope. What about the Norfolk Jubilee Quartet? What about everything else besides jazz that’s pretty good.
